unresolved.finding: Glob results are parsed using a raw prefix replacement and fixed path positions without validating the platform/configuration layout or supported configuration names.
Multiple ZIP files in one platform/configuration directory receive the same destination name and overwrite each other.
Paths, credentials and destination are concatenated unquoted into a shell command, so spaces or shell metacharacters can alter command interpretation.
Piping an unconditional yes into pscp accepts an initial host-key prompt without verifying the remote host identity.
The password is passed through command-line arguments to both the script and pscp, exposing it to process-command-line inspection.
Transfer output and exit status are discarded, allowing failed uploads to be reported as finished and an index to be published for missing artifacts.
An empty artifact glob still publishes an empty download index without reporting that no binaries were found.
Each transfer opens a null-output file without explicitly closing it.
Unquoted interpolation of executable paths, credentials and transfer paths into a shell command breaks on spaces or shell metacharacters.
The unconditional yes piped into pscp accepts an initial host-key prompt without identity verification.
Passwords are conveyed in process command-line arguments for both the distribution script and pscp.
Discarded transfer status and diagnostics allow failed uploads to appear successful and leave the published index pointing at absent artifacts.
The connection port is stored but never supplied to pscp, so a nondefault port is silently ignored.
Every archived file uses only its basename, flattening subdirectories and permitting duplicate member names that lose the original directory structure.
Missing configuration directories are silently skipped and an empty index is still uploaded when none exist.
Each put opens a null-output file without an explicit close, while the client close method does nothing.
The advertised entire-directory archive excludes every ZIP file, including ZIP resources unrelated to the generated output archive.
Relative depth multiplies the dispersion result by zero at the included zero-depth boundary without the explicit NaN treatment used for the velocity ratio.
Three-panel figures use different aspect ratios for PNG and EPS exports.
Combined plots select exactly four patches by child order without validating their count or associated contour levels.
Contour reconstruction assumes contour objects expose patch children with scalar FaceVertexCData, making the helper dependent on a particular graphics-object representation.
Reordering patches by contour level alone collapses distinct same-level contours and uses unchecked zero indices when a level has no match.
Removing NaN separators before creating a patch joins disconnected polygon segments and can fill regions that should remain separate.
Source discovery depends on the caller's working directory without checking that the expected source directories exist.
The output file handle is used without checking whether fopen succeeded.
Generated redirection and move commands do not quote filenames, so spaces or shell metacharacters in discovered filenames break the commands.
The generated batch script overwrites each original source with the temporary output even when findent fails or produces incomplete output.
Successful tests persist the same previous=true marker as started tests, so a subsequent runtests call can label a completed test as crashed and skip tests using a reset local numbering sequence.
A recovered crash sets failed_asserts but neither increments nofails nor invokes the failure hook.
A run that executes no tests unconditionally appends a crash row, potentially duplicating a recovered-crash row or reporting a crash for an empty suite.
Finalization executes a plain STOP regardless of failed assertions, leaving process-exit-based automation without a failure status.
Array shape or size failures update nofails and hooks but do not update HTML failure state, allowing the affected test to appear OK in HTML.
Array assertion helpers always pass addtext=false, so their HTML difference rows omit the assertion description.
Greater-than-only tolerance checks accept NaNs and can accept finite-versus-infinite values because neither nonfinite operands nor nonfinite thresholds are rejected.
The sum of operand magnitudes can overflow before multiplication by the tolerance and falsely accept materially different large finite values.
File comparisons silently discard content after 200 characters per line or 20 characters per token, so differences beyond those limits can pass.
Ignored list-directed tokenization errors and a literal question-mark sentinel can hide malformed or missing tokens, while numeric conversion uses only default-real precision.
Premature EOF or a read error reports a failed comparison without incrementing nofails.
Early returns on open or read failures leave any successfully opened comparison files connected.
Test descriptions and compared strings are embedded directly in HTML without escaping markup characters.
State and HTML report writes lack IOSTAT handling, so an output failure can terminate the test framework itself.
Public test and assertion entry points rely on runtests having initialized counters and test having allocated testname, but do not enforce or document those preconditions locally.
Test names and failure messages are inserted into quoted TeamCity service-message fields without escaping quotes, pipes, brackets or line breaks, which can corrupt test reporting.
The rank-three real writer serializes dimensions as REAL while its reader interprets them as INTEGER, producing invalid extents and potentially enormous allocations on ordinary round trips.
Array readers allocate directly from file extents without checking negative values, reasonable size limits or allocation status.
Retrieval unconditionally allocates pointer outputs without documenting or enforcing that their existing targets have been released, allowing repeated retrieval to leak prior allocations.
Detected storage errors terminate through plain STOP without returning an error or signaling assertion failure, which can appear as successful process termination.
Payload reads and all writes lack IOSTAT handling despite metadata-read checks, so truncated payloads or write failures bypass the module's controlled diagnostics.
The fixed format identifier records no kind widths, byte order or record-marker format even though payloads use compiler-native unformatted representations.
Character-array retrieval reports complex-data errors in two copy-pasted diagnostic messages.
C++ collective calls use C datatype and operation constants, relying on implementation-specific implicit conversions instead of the C++ binding constants.
The computed pi value is printed with default stream precision, concealing most of the numerical accuracy demonstrated by the example.
Root reads interactive input without EOF or conversion-error handling before broadcasting, so input failure can terminate root while peers wait in the collective.
Unbounded positive input permits a DO-loop terminal increment beyond the default-integer range for sufficiently large n.
MPE logging calls rely on an MPI profiling library to initialize and finish logging, but this file neither performs those calls explicitly nor states that link requirement.
Negative interval counts enter the calculation branch and report zero as the approximation instead of rejecting the input.
An accepted interval count near INT_MAX can overflow the signed loop index on its final increment, causing undefined behavior.
Functions return pointers to communicator ID records without documenting whether adding or merging communicators can invalidate those pointers.
The finite CLOG_MAXTIME sentinel is described as later than all times without specifying the timestamp origin or maximum supported duration.
CLOG_Pint is fixed at 32 bits despite being described as address-sized, restricting safe use to the intended 32-bit target.
The printf formats assume hhd and lld support and use ld for __int32, so compatibility with the Microsoft compiler and CRT version needs confirmation.
CLOG_UUID_SIZE expands to an unparenthesized sum, so multiplication or division involving the macro can compute the wrong size.
CLOG_Uuid_sprint accepts no destination capacity and does not explicitly state that callers must provide CLOG_UUID_STR_SIZE bytes.
The header defines MPEU_DLL_SPEC for import/export decoration but applies it to none of its function declarations.
Logging entry points accept byte-buffer pointers without documenting required readable length or null handling, while the pack interface implies a fixed MPE_LOG_BYTESIZE buffer.
Fortran logging and packing declarations provide neither argument interfaces nor a buffer-size constant, leaving callers without a local specification of the required byte-buffer storage.
MPE_Errors_to_dbx is declared outside the extern-C block, giving C++ callers incompatible linkage for the C library symbol.
MPIX and PMPIX generalized-request extensions are declared after the extern-C block closes, giving C++ callers incompatible linkage for C implementations.
The feature list defines MPIIMPL_HAVE_MPI_TYPE_CREATE_DARRAY twice and omits the corresponding TYPE_CREATE_SUBARRAY feature beside COMBINER_SUBARRAY.

The configured header fixes MPI_Aint to 32-bit int and defines MPI_CALL as cdecl without applying it to prototypes, so correct use depends on a 32-bit target and the compiler's default calling convention.
MPICH_SUPPRESS_PROTOTYPES suppresses MPI prototypes but leaves the PMPI prototype block enabled despite the comment describing suppression of prototypes generally.
NULL_COPY_FN sets flag=true without initializing attr_out, falsely reporting an attribute copy and potentially propagating an indeterminate attribute pointer.

Cartcomm::Sub always reads ten retain-dimension flags and allocates ten integers regardless of topology dimension, reading beyond ordinary short input arrays and undersizing the buffer for higher-dimensional topologies.
Alltoallw sizes and copies datatype arrays using local Get_size although an intercommunicator requires remote-group lengths, causing out-of-bounds accesses when group sizes differ.
Alltoallw dereferences the send-datatype array even for an in-place intracommunicator call where send arguments are ignored.
Spawn_multiple reads array_of_info on every rank even though those inputs are only significant on root, so valid nonroot placeholder arguments can be dereferenced.
Waitsome and Testsome copy incount status records instead of the returned outcount, reading temporary entries that MPI did not initialize.
Testall copies temporary statuses even when the completion flag is false and MPI leaves those statuses undefined.
Datatype::Get_contents and Cartcomm::Get_topo copy the requested maximum count rather than the actual returned datatype or topology count, potentially reading uninitialized temporary entries.
Raw temporary arrays are deleted only after MPI calls and error-handler dispatch, so exceptions from allocation or MPI error handlers leak earlier allocations.
Throwing from multi-request completion error handling occurs before updated handles and statuses are copied back, leaving caller requests stale after partial completion.
Scalar wrappers return uninitialized output locals if the MPI call fails and the configured error handler returns normally.
Clone methods ignore MPI_Comm_dup status and construct objects from an uninitialized ncomm on a returned error, unlike the checked Dup methods.
Grequest::Start is declared as an instance method rather than a static factory, preventing the expected class-qualified creation call.
Op query and local-reduction methods are non-const even though predefined operations are declared const, preventing direct calls on those objects.
MPIR_ARGUNUSED is never undefined despite the comment promising its removal at the end of the header.
MPIFCMB6 containing MPI_ERRCODES_IGNORE lacks the DLLIMPORT directive applied to the other sentinel common blocks, potentially preventing recognition of the shared-library sentinel.
Kind values, eight-byte integer syntax, DLL imports and common-block padding are compiler-specific with no local guard against an incompatible Fortran compiler or static-library configuration.
MPIO_Request aliases MPI_Request but MPIO_REQUEST_NULL remains zero instead of this implementation's nonzero MPI_REQUEST_NULL.

Including mpio.h first in C++ sets its guard before recursively including mpi.h, so mpi.h loads the C++ bindings before MPIO_Request and MPI-IO constants are available and the File interface is conditionally omitted.
Comments claim generalized requests are unimplemented despite this configured header enabling them and aliasing I/O requests to MPI requests.
Numeric array getters pass buffers to F77 routines that receive no capacity without first checking attribute length, allowing an oversized attribute to overwrite caller or temporary storage.
Scalar getters read an entire attribute into a one-element temporary without verifying that the attribute contains exactly one element.
Eight-byte integer writes narrow values to default integer before netCDF can range-check them, allowing out-of-range values to be silently corrupted.
Eight-byte integer getters first convert through default-integer temporaries, unnecessarily limiting the range that the wider destination can receive.
Getters copy temporary outputs regardless of read status and copy full temporary arrays even when the attribute is shorter, propagating undefined values on errors or unwritten elements.
Attribute inquiry overwrites the attnum lookup status and copies local type and length outputs even when their inquiry fails.
Text attribute writes strip trailing spaces, preventing exact round trips for strings whose trailing blanks are meaningful.
